create_flex_attention_causal_mask: create a causal attention mask for flex attention with a configurable maximum sequence length
create_flex_attention_sliding_window_mas: create a sliding window causal attention mask for flex attention with configurable window size and sequence length
flex_attention: build a flex attention function with a given query-pre-attention scalar and tanh logit softcap value
slow_attention_softcapping: run a compiled slow-path attention with logit softcapping using query, key, value tensors and causal mask
slow_inference_attention_softcapping: run an inference-time attention with logit softcapping using in-place tanh for memory efficiency
